### Problem & User Need
A clear and concise description of the user need or problem (e.g., "Lecturers need a quick way to postpone a class when traveling").

### Proposed Solution
Describe the solution or workflow you'd like to see implemented.

### Affected Team Roles
- [ ] Dev 1 (Frontend Student)
- [ ] Dev 2 (Frontend Admin/Lecturer)
- [ ] Dev 3 (Backend/Systems)
- [ ] Dev 4 (Platform/DevOps)

### Related Documentation
- Does this need a new or updated Spec in `docs/specs/`? (Yes / No)
- Relevant Spec (if known): `SPEC-00X`

### Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you considered.
